#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""
smash — unified Smash OS CLI for the full indies workflow.

Commands:
  new <title>           Create a chart project under ~/Charts
  list                  List projects
  open [title]          Open project folder (or Editor on export)
  from-audio <file>     Audio → MIDI (drums) into current/project
  from-midi <file>      MIDI → .indies package
  pipeline <audio>      Audio → MIDI → .indies in one shot
  export                Show/export status for project
  pack                  SmashRoms pack (validate + bundle)
  push-quest            ADB push .indies to Quest Install folder
  apply-quest           Run apply-installs on device
  editor                Launch Smash Drums Editor
  browser               Open Indies-DB
  doctor                Check tools, deps, device
  hub                   Launch graphical hub (yad if available)
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import argparse
import json
import os
import shutil
import subprocess
import sys
from datetime import datetime, timezone
from pathlib import Path

SMASHOS_ROOT = Path(os.environ.get("SMASHOS_ROOT", "/opt/smashos"))
TOOLS = SMASHOS_ROOT / "tools"
AUDIO_TO_MIDI = TOOLS / "audio-to-midi" / "audio_to_midi.py"
MIDI_TO_INDIES = TOOLS / "midi-to-indies" / "midi_to_smash.py"
SMASHROMS = TOOLS / "smashroms"
CHARTS = Path(os.environ.get("SMASH_CHARTS", str(Path.home() / "Charts")))
INDIES_DB = os.environ.get("INDIES_DB_URL", "https://indies-db.vercel.app")
QUEST_INSTALL = "/sdcard/SmashIndies/Install"
QUEST_INDIES = "/sdcard/Android/data/com.PotamWorks.SmashDrums/files/Indies"
CURRENT_FILE = Path.home() / ".config" / "smashos" / "current-project"


def die(msg: str, code: int = 1) -> None:
    print(msg, file=sys.stderr)
    sys.exit(code)


def run(cmd: list[str], **kwargs) -> subprocess.CompletedProcess:
    print("+", " ".join(cmd))
    return subprocess.run(cmd, check=False, **kwargs)


def ensure_charts() -> Path:
    CHARTS.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    (CHARTS / "Songs").mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    return CHARTS


def slugify(title: str) -> str:
    keep = []
    for ch in title.strip():
        if ch.isalnum() or ch in (" ", "-", "_"):
            keep.append(ch)
        else:
            keep.append("_")
    s = "".join(keep).strip().replace("  ", " ")
    return s or "Untitled"


def project_path(title: str | None = None) -> Path:
    ensure_charts()
    if title:
        return CHARTS / slugify(title)
    if CURRENT_FILE.is_file():
        p = Path(CURRENT_FILE.read_text(encoding="utf-8").strip())
        if p.is_dir():
            return p
    die("No current project. Use: smash new \"Song Name\"  or  smash open \"Song Name\"")


def set_current(path: Path) -> None:
    CURRENT_FILE.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    CURRENT_FILE.write_text(str(path.resolve()), encoding="utf-8")


def write_project_json(root: Path, title: str) -> None:
    meta = {
        "title": title,
        "created": datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(),
        "smashos": True,
        "paths": {
            "source": "source",
            "midi": "midi",
            "export": "export",
            "work": "work",
        },
    }
    (root / "project.json").write_text(json.dumps(meta, indent=2) + "\n", encoding="utf-8")


def cmd_new(args: argparse.Namespace) -> None:
    title = args.title
    root = project_path(title) if False else (ensure_charts() / slugify(title))
    if root.exists() and not args.force:
        die(f"Project already exists: {root}\n  Use --force to reuse, or smash open \"{title}\"")
    for sub in ("source", "midi", "export", "work"):
        (root / sub).mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    write_project_json(root, title)
    set_current(root)
    print(f"Created project: {root}")
    print(f"Current project set. Drop audio in: {root / 'source'}")


def cmd_list(_: argparse.Namespace) -> None:
    ensure_charts()
    cur = ""
    if CURRENT_FILE.is_file():
        cur = CURRENT_FILE.read_text(encoding="utf-8").strip()
    found = False
    for p in sorted(CHARTS.iterdir()):
        if not p.is_dir() or p.name.startswith("_") or p.name == "Songs":
            continue
        if (p / "project.json").is_file() or (p / "export").is_dir() or (p / "source").is_dir():
            mark = " *" if str(p.resolve()) == cur else ""
            print(f"{p.name}{mark}")
            found = True
    if not found:
        print("(no projects yet — smash new \"Song Name\")")


def cmd_open(args: argparse.Namespace) -> None:
    if args.title:
        root = ensure_charts() / slugify(args.title)
        if not root.is_dir():
            die(f"No project: {root}")
        set_current(root)
        print(f"Current project: {root}")
    else:
        root = project_path()
        print(f"Current project: {root}")
    if args.folder:
        for opener in ("xdg-open", "thunar", "pcmanfm"):
            if shutil.which(opener):
                run([opener, str(root)])
                return
    if args.editor:
        cmd_editor(argparse.Namespace())


def cmd_from_audio(args: argparse.Namespace) -> None:
    root = project_path(args.project) if args.project else project_path()
    audio = Path(args.file).expanduser().resolve()
    if not audio.is_file():
        die(f"Audio not found: {audio}")
    # Copy into project source if outside
    src_dir = root / "source"
    src_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    dest_audio = src_dir / audio.name
    if audio != dest_audio:
        shutil.copy2(audio, dest_audio)
        audio = dest_audio
    midi_dir = root / "midi"
    midi_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    if not AUDIO_TO_MIDI.is_file():
        die(f"Missing {AUDIO_TO_MIDI}")
    cmd = [sys.executable, str(AUDIO_TO_MIDI), str(audio), "--out", str(midi_dir)]
    if args.engine:
        cmd.extend(["--engine", args.engine])
    r = run(cmd)
    if r.returncode != 0:
        die("audio-to-midi failed", r.returncode)
    print(f"MIDI written under {midi_dir}")
    set_current(root)


def cmd_from_midi(args: argparse.Namespace) -> None:
    root = project_path(args.project) if args.project else project_path()
    midi = Path(args.file).expanduser().resolve()
    if not midi.is_file():
        # try project midi folder
        cand = root / "midi" / args.file
        if cand.is_file():
            midi = cand
        else:
            die(f"MIDI not found: {args.file}")
    export = root / "export"
    export.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    if not MIDI_TO_INDIES.is_file():
        die(f"Missing {MIDI_TO_INDIES}")
    cmd = [sys.executable, str(MIDI_TO_INDIES), str(midi), "--out", str(export)]
    # pull title from project.json
    pj = root / "project.json"
    if pj.is_file():
        try:
            meta = json.loads(pj.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
            if meta.get("title"):
                cmd.extend(["--title", meta["title"]])
        except json.JSONDecodeError:
            pass
    if args.audio:
        cmd.extend(["--audio", str(Path(args.audio).expanduser().resolve())])
    else:
        # first audio in source/
        for ext in (".ogg", ".wav", ".mp3", ".flac"):
            hits = list((root / "source").glob(f"*{ext}"))
            if hits:
                cmd.extend(["--audio", str(hits[0])])
                break
    r = run(cmd)
    if r.returncode != 0:
        die("midi-to-indies failed", r.returncode)
    print(f"Export under {export}")
    set_current(root)


def cmd_pipeline(args: argparse.Namespace) -> None:
    # ensure project
    if args.project:
        title = args.project
        root = ensure_charts() / slugify(title)
        if not root.is_dir():
            for sub in ("source", "midi", "export", "work"):
                (root / sub).mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
            write_project_json(root, title)
        set_current(root)
    else:
        try:
            root = project_path()
        except SystemExit:
            # create from audio filename
            audio = Path(args.file).expanduser()
            title = audio.stem
            root = ensure_charts() / slugify(title)
            for sub in ("source", "midi", "export", "work"):
                (root / sub).mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
            write_project_json(root, title)
            set_current(root)

    ns = argparse.Namespace(file=args.file, project=None, engine=args.engine)
    cmd_from_audio(ns)
    # pick newest midi
    midis = sorted((project_path() / "midi").glob("*.mid"), key=lambda p: p.stat().st_mtime, reverse=True)
    if not midis:
        midis = sorted((project_path() / "midi").glob("*.midi"), key=lambda p: p.stat().st_mtime, reverse=True)
    if not midis:
        die("No MIDI produced")
    ns2 = argparse.Namespace(file=str(midis[0]), project=None, audio=None)
    cmd_from_midi(ns2)
    print("Pipeline complete.")
    print(f"  project: {project_path()}")
    print(f"  export:  {project_path() / 'export'}")
    print("  next: smash editor   or   smash push-quest")


def cmd_export(_: argparse.Namespace) -> None:
    root = project_path()
    exp = root / "export"
    print(f"Project: {root}")
    if not exp.is_dir():
        print("No export/ yet")
        return
    files = list(exp.rglob("*.indies")) + list(exp.rglob("meta.json"))
    if not files:
        print("export/ is empty — smash from-midi or chart in Editor")
        return
    for f in sorted(files):
        print(f"  {f.relative_to(root)}  ({f.stat().st_size} bytes)")


def cmd_pack(args: argparse.Namespace) -> None:
    root = project_path()
    script = SMASHROMS / "pack.py"
    if not script.is_file():
        die(f"Missing {script}")
    cmd = [sys.executable, str(script), str(root)]
    if args.out:
        cmd.extend(["--out", args.out])
    r = run(cmd)
    if r.returncode != 0:
        die("pack failed", r.returncode)


def cmd_push_quest(args: argparse.Namespace) -> None:
    root = project_path()
    indies = list((root / "export").rglob("*.indies"))
    if args.file:
        indies = [Path(args.file).expanduser().resolve()]
    if not indies:
        die("No .indies in export/. Finish charting or smash from-midi first.")
    if not shutil.which("adb"):
        die("adb not found — install android-tools-adb (Smash OS should ship it)")
    # devices
    r = run(["adb", "devices"], capture_output=True, text=True)
    lines = [ln for ln in (r.stdout or "").splitlines() if "\tdevice" in ln]
    if not lines:
        die("No Quest/device in adb. Enable USB debugging and plug in.")
    run(["adb", "shell", "mkdir", "-p", QUEST_INSTALL])
    for f in indies:
        remote = f"{QUEST_INSTALL}/{f.name}"
        r = run(["adb", "push", str(f), remote])
        if r.returncode != 0:
            die(f"push failed: {f}")
    print(f"Pushed {len(indies)} file(s) to {QUEST_INSTALL}")
    print("Next: smash apply-quest   (or open Smash Indies Drag & Drop on headset)")


def cmd_apply_quest(_: argparse.Namespace) -> None:
    if not shutil.which("adb"):
        die("adb not found")
    local = SMASHROMS / "apply-installs-quest.sh"
    if local.is_file():
        run(["adb", "push", str(local), "/sdcard/SmashIndies/apply-installs.sh"])
    r = run(["adb", "shell", "sh", "/sdcard/SmashIndies/apply-installs.sh"])
    if r.returncode != 0:
        # fallback inline
        script = (
            f"mkdir -p {QUEST_INDIES}; "
            f"cp -f {QUEST_INSTALL}/*.indies {QUEST_INDIES}/ 2>/dev/null; "
            f"ls {QUEST_INDIES}"
        )
        run(["adb", "shell", "sh", "-c", script])
    print("Apply done. Open Smash Drums → Custom / Indies.")


def cmd_editor(_: argparse.Namespace) -> None:
    candidates = [
        shutil.which("smash-drums-editor"),
        "/opt/smashos/bin/smash-drums-editor",
        "/opt/SmashDrumsEditor/smash-drums-editor",
        str(SMASHOS_ROOT / "bin" / "smash-drums-editor"),
    ]
    # electron dev fallback
    editor_src = SMASHOS_ROOT / "packages" / "smash-drums-editor"
    for c in candidates:
        if c and Path(c).exists():
            run([c])
            return
    if (editor_src / "package.json").is_file() and shutil.which("npm"):
        print("Launching Editor (dev)…")
        run(["npm", "run", "desktop:dev"], cwd=str(editor_src))
        return
    # try desktop file
    if shutil.which("gtk-launch"):
        r = run(["gtk-launch", "smash-drums-editor"])
        if r.returncode == 0:
            return
    die("Smash Drums Editor not installed. Build packages/smash-drums-editor for Linux.")


def cmd_browser(_: argparse.Namespace) -> None:
    for b in ("firefox-esr", "firefox", "chromium", "google-chrome"):
        if shutil.which(b):
            run([b, INDIES_DB])
            return
    if shutil.which("xdg-open"):
        run(["xdg-open", INDIES_DB])
        return
    die("No browser found")


def cmd_doctor(_: argparse.Namespace) -> None:
    print("Smash OS doctor")
    print(f"  SMASHOS_ROOT={SMASHOS_ROOT}")
    print(f"  CHARTS={CHARTS}")
    print(f"  INDIES_DB={INDIES_DB}")
    for label, path in [
        ("audio_to_midi", AUDIO_TO_MIDI),
        ("midi_to_smash", MIDI_TO_INDIES),
        ("pack.py", SMASHROMS / "pack.py"),
    ]:
        ok = path.is_file()
        print(f"  [{'OK' if ok else 'MISSING'}] {label}: {path}")
    for dep in ("python3", "adb", "ffmpeg", "firefox-esr", "firefox", "openbox"):
        w = shutil.which(dep)
        if w:
            print(f"  [OK] {dep}: {w}")
    # python modules
    for mod in ("mido", "numpy", "librosa", "soundfile"):
        try:
            __import__(mod)
            print(f"  [OK] python:{mod}")
        except ImportError:
            print(f"  [MISSING] python:{mod}")
    if shutil.which("adb"):
        run(["adb", "devices"])
    if CURRENT_FILE.is_file():
        print(f"  current project: {CURRENT_FILE.read_text(encoding='utf-8').strip()}")
    else:
        print("  current project: (none)")


def cmd_hub(_: argparse.Namespace) -> None:
    hub = TOOLS / "hub" / "smash-hub"
    if hub.is_file():
        run([str(hub)])
        return
    # inline yad menu
    if not shutil.which("yad"):
        die("yad not installed; use smash CLI commands")
    out = subprocess.check_output(
        [
            "yad",
            "--list",
            "--title=Smash OS Hub",
            "--width=420",
            "--height=360",
            "--column=Action",
            "New project",
            "Open Charts folder",
            "Launch Editor",
            "Open Indies-DB",
            "Pipeline (audio→indies)",
            "Push to Quest",
            "Doctor",
            "--print-column=1",
        ],
        text=True,
    ).strip()
    actions = {
        "New project": lambda: run([sys.executable, __file__, "new", "Untitled"]),
        "Open Charts folder": lambda: run(["xdg-open", str(ensure_charts())]),
        "Launch Editor": lambda: cmd_editor(argparse.Namespace()),
        "Open Indies-DB": lambda: cmd_browser(argparse.Namespace()),
        "Pipeline (audio→indies)": lambda: die("Use: smash pipeline /path/to/audio.wav"),
        "Push to Quest": lambda: cmd_push_quest(argparse.Namespace(file=None)),
        "Doctor": lambda: cmd_doctor(argparse.Namespace()),
    }
    if out in actions:
        actions[out]()


def build_parser() -> argparse.ArgumentParser:
    p = argparse.ArgumentParser(prog="smash", description="Smash OS charting workflow CLI")
    sub = p.add_subparsers(dest="cmd", required=True)

    n = sub.add_parser("new", help="Create chart project")
    n.add_argument("title")
    n.add_argument("--force", action="store_true")
    n.set_defaults(func=cmd_new)

    sub.add_parser("list", help="List projects").set_defaults(func=cmd_list)

    o = sub.add_parser("open", help="Set current project")
    o.add_argument("title", nargs="?")
    o.add_argument("--folder", action="store_true")
    o.add_argument("--editor", action="store_true")
    o.set_defaults(func=cmd_open)

    fa = sub.add_parser("from-audio", help="Audio → MIDI into project")
    fa.add_argument("file")
    fa.add_argument("--project")
    fa.add_argument("--engine", default="drums")
    fa.set_defaults(func=cmd_from_audio)

    fm = sub.add_parser("from-midi", help="MIDI → .indies")
    fm.add_argument("file")
    fm.add_argument("--project")
    fm.add_argument("--audio")
    fm.set_defaults(func=cmd_from_midi)

    pl = sub.add_parser("pipeline", help="Audio → MIDI → .indies")
    pl.add_argument("file")
    pl.add_argument("--project")
    pl.add_argument("--engine", default="drums")
    pl.set_defaults(func=cmd_pipeline)

    sub.add_parser("export", help="Show exports").set_defaults(func=cmd_export)

    pk = sub.add_parser("pack", help="SmashRoms pack/validate")
    pk.add_argument("--out")
    pk.set_defaults(func=cmd_pack)

    pq = sub.add_parser("push-quest", help="ADB push .indies to Quest")
    pq.add_argument("--file")
    pq.set_defaults(func=cmd_push_quest)

    sub.add_parser("apply-quest", help="Apply Install → Smash Drums Indies on Quest").set_defaults(
        func=cmd_apply_quest
    )
    sub.add_parser("editor", help="Launch Editor").set_defaults(func=cmd_editor)
    sub.add_parser("browser", help="Open Indies-DB").set_defaults(func=cmd_browser)
    sub.add_parser("doctor", help="Environment check").set_defaults(func=cmd_doctor)
    sub.add_parser("hub", help="Graphical hub").set_defaults(func=cmd_hub)
    return p


def main() -> None:
    # Dev mode: tools next to this repo if /opt not present
    global SMASHOS_ROOT, TOOLS, AUDIO_TO_MIDI, MIDI_TO_INDIES, SMASHROMS
    if not AUDIO_TO_MIDI.is_file():
        here = Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent  # tools/
        if (here / "audio-to-midi" / "audio_to_midi.py").is_file():
            SMASHOS_ROOT = here.parent
            TOOLS = here
            AUDIO_TO_MIDI = TOOLS / "audio-to-midi" / "audio_to_midi.py"
            MIDI_TO_INDIES = TOOLS / "midi-to-indies" / "midi_to_smash.py"
            SMASHROMS = TOOLS / "smashroms"

    parser = build_parser()
    args = parser.parse_args()
    args.func(args)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

#!/usr/bin/env bash
# Lightweight graphical hub for Smash OS (yad). Falls back to terminal menu.
set -euo pipefail

SMASH="${SMASH:-smash}"
CHARTS="${SMASH_CHARTS:-$HOME/Charts}"
INDIES_DB="${INDIES_DB_URL:-https://indies-db.vercel.app}"

if command -v yad >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  choice=$(yad --list --title="Smash OS" --window-icon=applications-multimedia \
    --width=480 --height=400 --center --no-headers \
    --column=Action \
    "Launch Editor" \
    "New project…" \
    "Open Charts" \
    "Indies-DB (browser)" \
    "Pipeline: audio → indies…" \
    "Push current project to Quest" \
    "Apply installs on Quest" \
    "Pack SmashRom" \
    "Doctor" \
    --print-column=1) || exit 0
  choice=$(echo "$choice" | sed 's/|//g' | tr -d '\r')
  case "$choice" in
    "Launch Editor") exec $SMASH editor ;;
    "New project…")
      title=$(yad --entry --title="New project" --text="Song title:" --entry-text="Untitled") || exit 0
      exec $SMASH new "$title"
      ;;
    "Open Charts")
      mkdir -p "$CHARTS"
      exec xdg-open "$CHARTS"
      ;;
    "Indies-DB (browser)") exec $SMASH browser ;;
    "Pipeline: audio → indies…")
      f=$(yad --file --title="Pick audio" --file-filter="Audio|*.wav *.mp3 *.ogg *.flac *.m4a") || exit 0
      exec $SMASH pipeline "$f"
      ;;
    "Push current project to Quest") exec $SMASH push-quest ;;
    "Apply installs on Quest") exec $SMASH apply-quest ;;
    "Pack SmashRom") exec $SMASH pack ;;
    "Doctor") $SMASH doctor; yad --text-info --title="Doctor" --width=600 --height=400 --button=OK:0 < <($SMASH doctor 2>&1) ;;
  esac
  exit 0
fi

# Terminal fallback
echo "Smash OS Hub"
echo "  1) Editor"
echo "  2) New project"
echo "  3) Charts folder"
echo "  4) Indies-DB"
echo "  5) Doctor"
read -r -p "> " n
case "$n" in
  1) exec $SMASH editor ;;
  2) read -r -p "Title: " t; exec $SMASH new "$t" ;;
  3) mkdir -p "$CHARTS"; xdg-open "$CHARTS" ;;
  4) exec $SMASH browser ;;
  5) exec $SMASH doctor ;;
esac

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""
SmashRoms pack — validate a Smash OS chart project and build a ship bundle.

Bundle layout:
  <song>-smashrom/
    meta.json          # pack manifest
    charts/*.indies
    source/            # optional copies of audio/cover
    README.txt
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import argparse
import json
import shutil
import sys
import zipfile
from datetime import datetime, timezone
from pathlib import Path


def die(msg: str, code: int = 1) -> None:
    print(msg, file=sys.stderr)
    sys.exit(code)


def validate_indies(path: Path) -> list[str]:
    """Return list of warnings; raise via die on fatal."""
    warnings: list[str] = []
    if path.stat().st_size < 32:
        die(f"Fatal: {path.name} is tiny ({path.stat().st_size} bytes)")
    # .indies is zip-like (editor package)
    try:
        with zipfile.ZipFile(path, "r") as zf:
            names = zf.namelist()
            if not names:
                die(f"Fatal: {path.name} is an empty zip")
            lower = [n.lower() for n in names]
            if not any("meta.json" in n or n.endswith(".json") for n in lower):
                warnings.append(f"{path.name}: no meta.json inside package (may still load)")
    except zipfile.BadZipFile:
        # Some builds may use a different container; warn only
        warnings.append(f"{path.name}: not a zip container — leaving as opaque blob")
    return warnings


def pack_project(root: Path, out: Path | None) -> Path:
    root = root.resolve()
    if not root.is_dir():
        die(f"Not a project directory: {root}")

    title = root.name
    pj = root / "project.json"
    if pj.is_file():
        try:
            title = json.loads(pj.read_text(encoding="utf-8")).get("title", title)
        except json.JSONDecodeError:
            pass

    indies = list((root / "export").rglob("*.indies"))
    if not indies:
        die("No .indies under export/. Export from Editor or: smash from-midi …")

    all_warn: list[str] = []
    for f in indies:
        all_warn.extend(validate_indies(f))

    stamp = datetime.now(timezone.utc).strftime("%Y%m%d-%H%M%S")
    safe = "".join(c if c.isalnum() or c in "-_ " else "_" for c in title).strip().replace(" ", "_")
    bundle_name = f"{safe}-smashrom-{stamp}"
    if out:
        bundle = Path(out).expanduser().resolve()
        if bundle.suffix == ".zip":
            bundle_dir = bundle.with_suffix("")
        else:
            bundle_dir = bundle
    else:
        bundle_dir = root / "export" / bundle_name

    if bundle_dir.exists():
        shutil.rmtree(bundle_dir)
    charts = bundle_dir / "charts"
    charts.mkdir(parents=True)
    src_out = bundle_dir / "source"
    src_out.mkdir(parents=True)

    for f in indies:
        shutil.copy2(f, charts / f.name)
        print(f"  + charts/{f.name}")

    src = root / "source"
    if src.is_dir():
        for f in src.iterdir():
            if f.is_file():
                shutil.copy2(f, src_out / f.name)

    manifest = {
        "format": "smashrom",
        "version": 1,
        "title": title,
        "created": datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(),
        "charts": [p.name for p in indies],
        "warnings": all_warn,
        "quest": {
            "install_dir": "/sdcard/SmashIndies/Install",
            "indies_dir": "/sdcard/Android/data/com.PotamWorks.SmashDrums/files/Indies",
        },
    }
    (bundle_dir / "meta.json").write_text(json.dumps(manifest, indent=2) + "\n", encoding="utf-8")
    (bundle_dir / "README.txt").write_text(
        f"""SmashRom bundle: {title}
Created: {manifest['created']}

Install on Quest:
  1. smash push-quest   (from Smash OS)
  2. smash apply-quest
  3. Open Smash Drums → Custom / Indies

Or copy charts/*.indies into Smash Indies Install / game Indies folder.
""",
        encoding="utf-8",
    )

    zip_path = bundle_dir.with_suffix(".zip")
    if zip_path.exists():
        zip_path.unlink()
    with zipfile.ZipFile(zip_path, "w", compression=zipfile.ZIP_DEFLATED) as zf:
        for f in bundle_dir.rglob("*"):
            if f.is_file():
                zf.write(f, f.relative_to(bundle_dir.parent).as_posix())

    print(f"Packed: {bundle_dir}")
    print(f"Zip:    {zip_path}")
    for w in all_warn:
        print(f"  warn: {w}")
    return zip_path


def main() -> None:
    ap = argparse.ArgumentParser(description="SmashRoms pack/validate")
    ap.add_argument("project", type=Path, help="Project root (~/Charts/Song)")
    ap.add_argument("--out", help="Output dir or .zip path")
    args = ap.parse_args()
    pack_project(args.project, Path(args.out) if args.out else None)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

#!/system/bin/sh
# Apply staged Smash Indies maps into Smash Drums.
# Runs ON the Quest (via: adb shell sh /sdcard/SmashIndies/apply-installs.sh)
#
# Or from phone Termux after pushing this file to the Quest.

SRC="/sdcard/SmashIndies/Install"
DST="/sdcard/Android/data/com.PotamWorks.SmashDrums/files/Indies"

echo "Smash Indies apply"
echo "  from: $SRC"
echo "  to:   $DST"

mkdir -p "$DST"

count=0
for f in "$SRC"/*.indies; do
  # No matches → literal glob left as-is on some shells
  if [ ! -f "$f" ]; then
    continue
  fi
  name=$(basename "$f")
  cp -f "$f" "$DST/$name" && count=$((count + 1)) && echo "  + $name"
done

if [ "$count" -eq 0 ]; then
  echo "No .indies files in $SRC"
  echo "Download maps in Smash Indies (Indies-DB) first."
  exit 0
fi

echo "Done. Installed $count map(s). Open Smash Drums → Custom / Indies."
ls "$DST"

# Smash OS tools

All charting tooling lives here and is installed to `/opt/smashos/tools` on the image.

| Path | Role |
|------|------|
| `pipeline/smash` | Unified CLI + workflow hub entry |
| `hub/smash-hub` | Lightweight GUI (yad) |
| `audio-to-midi/` | Drum-first audio → GM MIDI |
| `midi-to-indies/` | MIDI → `.indies` + editor folders |
| `smashroms/pack.py` | Validate + pack ship bundles |
| `smashroms/apply-installs-quest.sh` | On-device Install → game Indies |
| `requirements.txt` | Python deps for the pipeline |

On Smash OS, invoke via `smash …` only — paths stay consistent.
